phaseDescription.period: Menstrual days — the body sheds the uterine lining and energy is often lower.
phaseDescription.follicular: After the period the body prepares for ovulation and energy gradually rises.
phaseDescription.fertile: Days in the fertility window — the chance of conception is higher.
phaseDescription.ovulation: The estimated ovulation day — the highest chance of conception.
phaseDescription.luteal: After ovulation until the next period — mood swings or fatigue are common.

nextPeriod.label: Until next period
nextPeriod.phaseDesc: Your body is preparing for a new cycle. You may experience mood swings, fatigue or sensitivity — take care of yourself and rest a little.

challenge.title: Today's challenge
challenge.desc: Great week so far! Keep it up.

smartTip.title: Smart tip
smartTip.body: In the luteal phase, your body needs extra care. Don't forget whole grains and vegetables.
smartTip.quote: Every day is a new opportunity to take care of yourself.

weekSummary.title: Week summary
weekSummary.subtitle: Average of the last 7 days
weekSummary.loggedDays: {n, plural, one{# day logged} other{# days logged}}

tone.none: Nothing logged for this week yet.
tone.unscored: You logged this week, but not your mood, sleep or energy.
tone.low: A tough week — go easy on yourself and rest.
tone.mixed: A mixed week. Keep going, you're tracking it.
tone.good: Great week so far! Keep it up.

weekSummary.error: This week's summary isn't available right now.

values.title: Cycle length
values.suggestion: Based on your recent logs, your cycle looks closer to {n, number} days.

ring.label: Cycle ring: day {day, number} of {length, number}
ring.usually: Usually {n, plural, one{# day} other{# days}}

noData.title: Add your last period
noData.text: Once you add when your last period started, your cycle forecast and daily message will show up here.

endMissing.title: Period end not logged yet
endMissing.text: If it has ended, log it; if it's still going, there's nothing to do.

nb.nearText: {days, plural, =0 {Your period will likely start today.} =1 {Your period will likely start tomorrow.} other {Your period will likely start in {n} days.}} If it starts, log it right here so the next prediction gets sharper.
nb.lateText: Your period is {n} days past the predicted date. If it has started, log it here; a few days late is usually normal.
nb.lateTextLong: Your period is {n} days past the predicted date. If it has started, log it here. If not, check the date of your last period.

overdue.title: Your period is {n} days late
overdue.text: If your period has started, log it. If you might be pregnant, you can log a test result.
overdue.textLong: It has been over two weeks past the predicted date. Check the date of your last period. If you are worried or might be pregnant, talk to a doctor.
overdue.textNoTest: If your period has started, log it.
overdue.textLongNoTest: It has been over two weeks past the predicted date. Check the date of your last period. If you are worried, talk to a doctor.

askLast.title: Tell us your last period date
askLast.text: Predictions are counted from your last period date, and right now they are out of date.

note.hormonal: With hormonal birth control, this bleed comes from the hormone break, not an ovulation cycle, so fertile days aren't shown.
note.postpartum: After giving birth, cycles take a while to come back. Predictions start once you've logged two periods.
note.age45: From around 45, changes in cycle length are common, so treat predictions as approximate.

insight.basis: Based on your last {n} cycles · see analysis
insight.basisBasic: Based on your past cycles · see analysis

pregnancyPrompt.title: Switch to pregnancy mode
pregnancyPrompt.body: You logged a positive test. If you'd like, you can switch Ritme to pregnancy mode.

sheet.title: Period didn't come?
sheet.body: If your period did not arrive on time, you can log this cycle as having no period. Predictions will count one cycle further from now on, and nothing is removed from your history. You can undo it whenever you like.

toast.text: Saved. Predictions moved one cycle ahead.

note.text: You logged this cycle as no period.

errors.notExpectedYet: It is too early. This option opens on the day your period is predicted.
errors.periodStarted: A period is already logged for this cycle, so you do not need this.
errors.predictionMismatch: Your prediction changed. We refreshed it, so take another look.
errors.network: Could not connect. Please try again.
errors.generic: That did not work. Please try again in a moment.
errors.undo: Could not undo. Please try again.

menopause.title: How are you today?
menopause.body: Log hot flashes, sleep and mood to see how your symptoms change.
menopause.trendSub: The pattern of what you’ve logged

postpartum.title: Postpartum home is coming soon
postpartum.body: Recovery, breastfeeding and baby’s growth will live here soon. Until then you’ll see cycle tracking.
